relevance.why: Cheap offloading of heavy tasks is relevant, but this is an unknown provider (Gonka = decentralized/crypto inference network), fingerprint-login, and the Claude Code routing step is hand-waved. Liked set already has NVIDIA free endpoints and OmniRoute.

implement_score.why: Not worth the trust risk for client/app code. If cheap DeepSeek is wanted, use NVIDIA's free endpoints or DeepSeek's own API (both already liked). Skip.

verify: What is Dahl / Gonka? Is it a decentralized GPU network and what happens to prompts sent through it (privacy, retention)?

Which 'compatible gateway' routes an OpenAI-compatible endpoint into Claude Code (claude-code-router, LiteLLM)?
Is the creator affiliated/sponsored (link in bio)?

gap.what: New provider name (Dahl/Gonka) with a 100M-token no-signup grant; the technique (route a cheap open model into Claude Code) duplicates liked NVIDIA/OmniRoute content
